$comment: Type-checks everything `bun x tsc` never sees. The shipped tsconfig.json has rootDir=src and excludes the specs, so the build compiles neither them nor prisma/seed.ts — and `bun test` runs the specs without checking them, so nothing in the repository did. Turning this on immediately found a test double referencing an undeclared variable and a create DTO that had gained a required field, neither of which any other step could see.
